	<ResortReportHeadline>Super Saturday!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It looks like a glorious day on the way.&nbsp; The sky is clear, the snow guns are blazing and there is just a puff of a breeze from the north.&nbsp; The overnight low was minus 5.8, the current temp is minus 4.8 and we are heading for a very pleasant top of 4 degrees.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>The snow has firmed up a little since yesterday but the groomers I kicked on the way to the office have some nice dry texture on top.&nbsp; It should be a good morning for carving turns on the piste, and some of the off-piste zones should be riding well too.&nbsp; The sunny aspects should soften further as the day warms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Get out there and make the most of the easy conditions today, as it looks like things are going to get real tomorrow. Stay tuned!&nbsp; Road Runner will be spinning at 7.30am for First Tracks this morning.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>And get along to support our incredible Volunteer Ski Patrol at the Big Gig fundraising auction tonight.&nbsp; The General at 8.30pm.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>

Beware of a slide hazard, especially at lower elevations, where the snow became warmer yesterday, and has now frozen due to the cold overnight temps.  Take care.</Backcountry>
